task: Predict TP53 mutation status in colon adenocarcinoma. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. On H&E, TP53-mutant tumors are more often associated with higher nuclear atypia, complex glandular architecture, increased mitotic activity, necrosis, and infiltrative aggressive growth.

classes.0: TP53 wildtype tumor with relatively lower-grade cytology and more orderly gland-forming morphology.
classes.1: TP53 mutant tumor showing marked nuclear pleomorphism, complex architecture, brisk mitotic activity, and necrotic aggressive growth.
